name: cache-warmer
description: Keeps the prompt cache warm while the session is idle, with a tiny forked ping that adds nothing to the transcript

intervalMinutes.title: Ping after N idle minutes
intervalMinutes.description: Minutes since the last request before a ping. Keep it under the cache TTL (60 for a 1-hour cache, 4 for a 5-minute one)

maxPings.title: Max pings in a row
maxPings.description: Pings without any activity from you before it gives up
